note: Webform Analysis adds a per-webform Analysis results tab (/admin/structure/webform/manage/{webform}/results/analysis, route entity.webform.results_analysis) that charts submission stats. Its configuration is stored as THIRD-PARTY SETTINGS on the webform config entity under namespace 'webform_analysis': components (element keys array), chart_type (''=Table|PieChart|ColumnChart), start_date, end_date (timestamps), in_draft (bool). Chart choices come from WebformAnalysis::getChartTypeOptions(). No global settings page, no own permission (reuses webform's view-any-submission access), no Drush. Medium/hard cases use a dedicated fixture webform 'wanalysis_fixture' (elements: satisfaction select, newsletter checkbox) and only toggle its third-party settings, which is a clean, route-neutral operation on this shared site.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the webform_analysis module, where do I view the statistics/analysis for a webform's submissions, and what chart display types does the module offer?
evals.expected_output: Each webform gets an 'Analysis' tab under its Results at /admin/structure/webform/manage/{webform}/results/analysis (route entity.webform.results_analysis). Chart types (WebformAnalysis::getChartTypeOptions) are Table (''), PieChart, and ColumnChart.

evals.prompt: In the webform_analysis module, where are a webform's analysis settings (which elements to analyse and the chart type) stored, and what are the setting keys?
evals.expected_output: They are stored as third-party settings on the webform config entity under the 'webform_analysis' namespace: components (array of element keys), chart_type ('' | PieChart | ColumnChart), start_date, end_date (timestamps) and in_draft (bool). There is no global settings page.

evals.prompt: Using the webform_analysis module, how would I compute the count of each submitted value for a webform element in code, and what is the id of the block the module provides for embedding analysis?
evals.expected_output: Instantiate the handler: $a = new Drupal\webform_analysis\WebformAnalysis($webform); then $a->getComponentValuesCount('element_key') returns value => count (querying webform_submission_data, honouring in_draft and date filters). The provided block plugin id is webform_analysis_block.

evals.prompt: On this site, the webform with id 'wanalysis_fixture' has webform_analysis configured. Inspect the live configuration and report which chart type it uses and which element(s) it analyses.
evals.expected_output: The wanalysis_fixture webform's third-party settings under webform_analysis have chart_type 'PieChart' and components ['satisfaction'].

evals.prompt: The webform 'wanalysis_fixture' on this site has webform_analysis set up to analyse some of its elements and has a setting about draft submissions. Inspect the live configuration and report which elements are analysed and whether draft submissions are included.
evals.expected_output: wanalysis_fixture's webform_analysis third-party settings have components ['satisfaction','newsletter'] and in_draft = true (draft submissions are included).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the webform_analysis module to configure the webform 'wanalysis_fixture' so that its 'satisfaction' element is analysed and displayed as a Column Chart. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the wanalysis_fixture webform's webform_analysis third-party settings: components to include 'satisfaction' and chart_type to 'ColumnChart' (e.g. $w->setThirdPartySetting('webform_analysis','components',['satisfaction']); $w->setThirdPartySetting('webform_analysis','chart_type','ColumnChart'); $w->save();).

evals.prompt: On my Drupal site I want the results of the 'satisfaction' question on the webform 'wanalysis_fixture' shown as a pie chart on that webform's analysis page. Set that up using the webform analysis module and save it.
evals.expected_output: Set the wanalysis_fixture webform's webform_analysis third-party settings: components to include 'satisfaction' and chart_type to 'PieChart', then save the webform.
